items.headline: US military disables ship trying to breach Iran blockade
items.summary: The merchant vessel was stopped near the Strait of Hormuz, the US military said.

items.headline: Kyiv offers Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports
items.summary: Ukraine proposed a truce at sea to keep its grain shipments moving.

items.headline: Italy says Iranian-made drone killed two Italians in Kuwait
items.summary: Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said the drone used in the deadly strike in Kuwait was made in Iran.

items.headline: FTSE 100 ends week up 3.4% as miners and banks rally
items.summary: The index rose 0.84% on Friday to 10,698.81, helped by stronger gold and copper prices and a rebound in US shares.

items.headline: Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy and halts flights
items.summary: The low-cost transatlantic airline has stopped flying and selling tickets.

items.headline: Bank of England December rate rise still on the table
items.summary: London outpaced Frankfurt and Paris on Friday, with rate-setters keeping open the option of a December hike.

items.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
items.summary: The legal fight between the two companies escalates as the AI race heats up.

items.headline: Restricted Nvidia chips traced to Shanghai data centre, Bloomberg says
items.summary: The Blackwell chips, barred from sale to China, were linked to a centre tied to the woman in Jensen Huang's affair scandal.

items.headline: US regulator clears AI tool that predicts breast cancer risk
items.summary: The FDA approved DeepHealth's tool, which assesses risk using existing 3D mammogram scans.
